info.name: IT Asset Management API
info.description:
Collection lengkap untuk IT Asset Management API

## Setup

1. Import collection ini ke Postman
    
2. Import environment `IT Asset Management - Environment.json`
    
3. Jalankan endpoint **Login** terlebih dahulu
    
4. Token otomatis tersimpan ke variable `{{token}}`
    

## Base URL

`http://it-asset-api.test/api`

## Flow Testing

1. Auth → Register / Login
    
2. Categories → CRUD
    
3. Assets → CRUD
    
4. Asset Properties → CRUD
    
5. Maintenance Logs → CRUD
    
6. Audit Logs → CRUD
    
7. Asset Assignments → CRUD
    
8. Logs → GET only
